Cost: [REDACTED] (Super Luxury, at minimum)

This does not exist. Any blurry video or now-dead journalist’s report you’ve seen is a fake. The second-hand stories of supposed ‘survivors’ of encounters in the third world against this non-existent machine whispered at weapons expos are pure fabrications. Militech is not developing an exosuit with optical-camo ballistic shields, smartlinked electronic 5000-RPM machine guns, auto-guided mortars, reinforced hydraulics, and super-dense myomar musculature, all at a smaller physical size and weight than any other exosuit ever designed. Because they’ve already developed it.

Of course, they’ll never admit it. Nobody’s even sure what its official name is, though one account claims the word “SPECTER” is on its chest. How they got close enough to see that and survived to tell the tale is unknown. While its true capabilities remain shrouded in secrecy, one thing is clear: The SPECTER is Militech’s vision for what they believe will dominate the next war. But don’t worry about it, because it doesn’t exist.

The Specialized Protective Exosuit for Covert Tactical Engagement and Response (SPECTER) is a Linear Frame that can only be purchased as an External Frame. Connecting to this frame requires 3 installations of Interface Plugs, and taking it on or off requires 3 Actions. While connected properly to the frame, the user’s BODY increases to 14, their MOVE is set to 6 (Unless their base MOVE is higher, in which case that takes over), REF, DEX, and MOVE penalties they suffer from worn armor or wielded weapons are halved (Round Up), and they operate as if they had installed Jump Boosters, Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrades (Legs), and Skate Feet. The increase in BODY does not increase or modify the user’s HP or Death Save.

While connected properly to this frame and using both hands to utilize its specialized controls, the user can operate a pair of back-mounted robotic arms that function as Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mounts which can be independently aimed in any direction the user can see. Weapons installed into these mounts can always be wielded One-Handed, are considered connected to the user for the purposes of Smart Rebuilds, Smartgun Links, or other similar requirements, and are impossible to be dropped or knocked out of the user’s hand via an Aimed Shot.

This frame is considered Hardened, and thus cannot be disabled by any EMP, Microwaver, or other Black-ICE style effect. Thanks to reinforced redundancy protocols, this frame cannot be affected by Quickhacks or otherwise disabled via netrunning. There is a manual release to extract injured pilots on the frame’s chest that requires a corresponding security code, but good luck getting close enough to punch that in during combat.

Either arm mount can (in place of a weapon) also accept a custom Advanced Optical Shield (25 HP Bulletproof Shield, counts as 2 always-active installations of FBC Chameleon Coating when viewed from the front at a distance greater than 25m/yds). Either arm mount can also equip custom weaponry that only function when installed into this frame: The EX-75 IronWind and EX-76 EarthBreaker, which are detailed below.

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo lists no exact price; see Cost.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > External Linear Frames).
